briefing: NASDAQ (-0.7%) and S&P 500 (-0.6%) both drifted lower today, a mild risk-off tone rather than a clear buy signal. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, the screener shows strong individual setups (CRUS, STNE, SNAP with full signal confirmation), but per our own playbook we don't force deployment on a soft/red market day — holding cash and existing positions until a genuine risk-on confirmation (broad index strength, not just single-stock technicals) appears.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets, causing major indices to dip even without one specific bad-news trigger. On days like this, it's often wiser to hold cash and existing positions rather than chase individual stocks that look strong, since broad market weakness can drag even good setups down with it.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指投資者普遍減少持有風險較高的資產，即使沒有單一明確的利空消息，大盤指數也會下跌。在這類日子，持有現金和現有部位通常比追逐個別強勢股更明智，因為大盤整體疲弱可能連累原本不錯的個股表現。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.7% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%, reflecting broad-based caution rather than any single dramatic catalyst. Days like this often see a handful of individual stocks with strong technical setups even as the overall market drifts lower, which is exactly the divergence seen in today's screener results. Without a clear market-wide risk-on trigger, it's prudent to treat isolated strong stock signals with more skepticism than usual.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍走軟，納斯達克指數下跌0.7%，標普500指數下跌0.6%，市場氣氛偏向審慎，並無單一重大利空觸發。這類日子常見個別股票技術面仍然強勁，即使大盤整體回落，今日篩選結果中的分歧正是如此。在缺乏明確的大盤風險偏好訊號下，對個股單一強勢訊號應保持更高的警惕。
